description: Variation of conditions 2 (compliance with approved drawings) and 14 (approved details (except bricks)) of planning permission PP/22/01420 for reduction in height to 30 Pembridge Crescent element of building (removal of glazed upward extension), changes to roof structure arrangement within parapet level, altered locations and reduction of scale of rooflights and introduction of hatch for maintenance purposes; replacement of existing pitched roof at mews; creation of new front internal garden (by opening up roof of entrance lobby area); alternative design to entrance doors (on Pembridge Crescent and Portobello Mews); changes to fenestration (alterations to consented windows in terms of positioning, reducing number in scale and materials/design of obscure glazing); removing creation of terrace on eastern elevation.
site_name: 30 Pembridge Crescent and 3 Portobello Mews, LONDON, W11 3DS
